Scope.Included: Production-shaped cap-one whole flow. Dense uses DirtyEntitySpatialFanout with 1,000 public entities and two-percent spatial dirt; sparse uses MaintainedEntityRelation with one moving public entity per recipient and thirty-five-percent spatial dirt.
Scope.Excluded: Each series stops after retaining its first completed population with server-role tick p95 greater than 33.000 ms. Cold construction/bootstrap and semantic verification remain outside timed ticks.
Scope.AggregationExperiment: This is a localhost server-role rating observation, not a public-WAN CCU or latency SLA. p99/max are retained as tail context; p95 is the stop criterion. Protocol/listener stage probes were disabled. Dense starts at 128 by 64; sparse starts at 512 by 128. The server semantic tick duration was 33 ms. AOI cadence was Default012.
